description: NaSb₅O₈ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.91 Å. There are five inequivalent Sb sites. In the first Sb site, Sb is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.63 Å. In the second Sb site, Sb is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.26 Å. In the third Sb site, Sb is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.27 Å. In the fourth Sb site, Sb is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.53 Å. In the fifth Sb site, Sb is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.45 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two Sb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three Sb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two Sb atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Sb atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaSb₃ trigonal pyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two Sb atoms to form distorted ONa₂Sb₂ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONaSb₃ trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Sb₂ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONaSb₃ trigonal pyramid. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four Sb atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two Sb atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and three Sb atoms.
